origin.description: Every column that is not named is skipped.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: The data, path, or collector this function accepts.

origin.details: Every column that is not named is skipped.
origin.value: The same value readr 2.2.0 returns for this case, written as one line in the output.
origin.example:
spec <- cols_only(a = col_double())
paste(class(spec$default)[1], names(spec$cols)[1], class(spec$cols[[1]])[1], sep = ";")
